title: Permanent warning next to BG number
symptom: In AndroidAPS 3.0.0.1, a warning icon appears permanently next to the BG number even though data is sent every 5 minutes from xDrip. The warning is disquieting and seems unnecessary when everything is working fine.
cause: The warning triangle indicates that there was an irregularity outside tolerance within the last 30 hours of BG data used for calculations. It can be triggered by BG readings that are not exactly 5 minutes apart, such as 4 minutes from the previous reading. This is common for Libre users because xDrip does not calculate values exactly every 5 minutes.
fix: No official fix was provided in the thread. A user created a fork of AndroidAPS 3.0.1 with the warning disabled as a temporary workaround, but this is unofficial and at the user's own risk.
evidence_quote: AAPS uses around last 30 hours of BGs for calculations. triangle means the irregularity outside tolerance appeared within this period.
